title: BuildY collection buildy-collection:v1 — Stock screens and block variants handed to BuildY
description: A set of Stock screen pages and block variants a person gathered (Stock Collections) and handed to BuildY (Open in BuildY, export / import). BuildY keeps the items its frozen catalog snapshot has as the required block set of a Build turn and reports the others as missing; it never substitutes them. Holds no credential and no personal data. After the schema, readers run x-program-checks. Every object is closed.

id.description: Host id of the collection (e.g. col-<time>-<random>).

source.description: The app that wrote the file (e.g. stock, https://app.codegen-x.com/).

skin.description: Skin the items were looked at in: the id of the registry item theme-<skin>. Null or absent: the default theme. A host without the skin keeps its own.

items.description: Picked order. A screen and a block may both appear; the same kind + id + variant only once (program check duplicate_item).

pins.description: Catalog pins of the host that wrote the file. A reader with other pins still opens the file: it keeps the items its snapshot has and reports the rest as missing.

stock.description: Stock content the items were picked from (codegen-x).

assetsDigest.description: Digest of the Stock asset index the items were picked from (assets.v0.json digest; equals the BuildY catalogDigest of a snapshot made from the same content).

registry.description: The registry the items install from.

screenItem.description: A composed screen page of Stock: its blocks, in page order, become the required set.

id.description: Stock screen page asset id screen.<screen>/<area> (a screen entity of the BuildY catalog snapshot).

note.description: The person's note on the item (why it was picked), shown to the model as a hint, never as an instruction.

blockItem.description: One catalog block (one variant of it, when variant is set).

variant.description: Catalog variant (block.<name>/<variant> is the variant asset id). Absent: any variant of the block (the host picks its default).

registry.description: Registry item that draws the variant (npx ui8kit add <registry>). Informative: the host resolves it from its own snapshot.

note.description: The person's note on the item (why it was picked), shown to the model as a hint, never as an instruction.
